表示状态或性质的名词后缀

definition_zh: 发出；排放；散发；说出
definition_en: to send out light, heat, sound or gas; to utter something; to issue
core_image: 炉口张开，热浪和光一起被送向四周
scene: 炉火正旺，热浪一阵阵从炉口涌出。 The old stove emitted a steady wave of heat.
sceneCN: 这里 emit 是「散发出」（第 01 个义项：把光、热、声音或气体送出）；句意是旧炉子持续散发热浪。

pos.zh: 及物动词：发出；排放；散发；说出

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ion 构成，义为「排放；发射」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「发射体；排放源」
由词干加 -ive 构成，义为「发射的；放射的」

senses.title: To send out light, heat or sound
senses.definition: to send out energy such as light, heat, sound or radiation
senses.definitionCN: 把光、热、声音或辐射等能量送出去
senses.example: The old stove emitted a steady wave of heat.
senses.exampleCN: 旧炉子持续散发热浪。
senses.why: The Latin verb joins e-, out, with mittere, to send, so emit is literally to send something outward.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词由 e-（向外）与 mittere（发送）组合，所以 emit 字面就是「往外送」。

senses.title: To send out gas or waste
senses.definition: to release gas, smoke or other waste into the environment
senses.definitionCN: 把气体、烟雾或其他废物释放到环境中
senses.example: The factory emits less smoke than before.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂排放的烟比以前少。
senses.why: The same outward sending applies to unwanted substances, so the verb became the standard word for pollution sources.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「往外送」也适用于不想要的物质，于是这个动词成了描述污染源的标准词。

senses.title: To utter or express
senses.definition: to say or express something, especially a sound or opinion
senses.definitionCN: 说出或表达某物，尤指声音或意见
senses.example: She emitted a sigh of relief.
senses.exampleCN: 她松了一口气。
senses.why: A voice sends sound outward as a lamp sends light, so the verb extends from physical energy to human utterance.
senses.whyCN: 嗓音把声音送出去，就像灯把光送出去，于是这个动词从物理能量延伸到人的言语。

intro.en: Emit is a direct borrowing from Latin emittere, to send out.
intro.cn: emit 直接借自拉丁语 emittere，意为「送出」。

items.en: Mittere meant to send or let go.
items.cn: mittere 意为发送、放出。

items.en: With e-, out, the verb meant to send forth.
items.cn: 加上 e-（向外）后，动词意为送出、发出。

items.en: Its participle emissus described something sent out.
items.cn: 其分词 emissus 形容被送出的东西。

items.en: English borrowed emit for sending out light and sound.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入 emit，表示发出光与声音。

items.en: Industry and science extended it to gases, radiation and emissions.
items.cn: 工业与科学又把它扩展到气体、辐射与排放物。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the mittere family; the near-meaning group separates releasing, discharging and giving off.
note.cn: 形近组沿着 mittere 词族展开；近义组区分释放、排放与散发。

entries.definition: The act of sending out, or what is sent out.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「排放、发射」，也指排放物。

entries.definition: A device or source that emits.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「发射体、排放源」。

entries.definition: To send across, built on the same Latin verb with trans-.
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「传送」，由同一个拉丁动词加 trans- 构成。

entries.definition: To let something go out or free.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「释放」，强调放开。

entries.definition: To send out a substance, often in a steady flow.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「排放」，常指持续流出。

entries.definition: To produce a smell, heat or light.
entries.definitionCN: 短语动词，义为「散发出」气味、热或光。

normalIntro.en: These hooks read emit as e- plus mit, out plus send, then let the outward send cover light, smoke and speech.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把 emit 读成 e- 加 mit，即「向外送」，再让这股外送覆盖光、烟与言语。

normal.en: E- means out and mit means send: send out.
normal.cn: e- 表示向外，mit 表示发送：送出去。

normal.en: A lamp emits light every evening.
normal.cn: 灯每晚都在发光。

normal.en: A chimney emits smoke.
normal.cn: 烟囱排放烟雾。

normal.en: Emission is the noun made with -ion.
normal.cn: emission 是加 -ion 构成的名词。

normal.en: Transmit is the same send with trans-.
normal.cn: transmit 是同一个「送」，加上 trans-。

abstract.en: Picture heat leaving a stove as visible waves.
abstract.cn: 想象热浪从炉口离开，变成看得见的波纹。

abstract.en: Every sense is something crossing an edge outward.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都是某物越过边缘向外走。

abstract.en: Emit is a one-way door for energy and words.
abstract.cn: emit 就是一道让能量与话语只出不进的单向门。

examples.en: The old stove emitted a steady wave of heat.
examples.cn: 旧炉子持续散发热浪。

examples.en: The factory emits less smoke than before.
examples.cn: 这家工厂排放的烟比以前少。

examples.en: She emitted a sigh of relief.
examples.cn: 她松了一口气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一秘特」——炉子一开，热浪偷偷往外送

root: 拉丁语 emittere，由 e-（向外）加 mittere（发送）构成，字面为「送出、发出」。

sensesIntro.en: Emit sends light and heat out, then smoke and waste, then a voice or a sigh.
sensesIntro.cn: emit 先把光和热送出去，再送出烟与废物，最后送出嗓音或一声叹息。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stove mouth opening and sending heat outward.
core.cn: 核心意象：炉口张开，把热浪往外送。

branches.en: THE ENERGY: light, heat and radiation.
branches.cn: 能量线：光、热与辐射。

branches.en: THE WASTE: smoke and gases sent into the air.
branches.cn: 废物线：烟与气体被送进空气。

branches.en: THE VOICE: a sound or sigh sent out.
branches.cn: 声音线：嗓音或叹息被送出。

branches.en: GOOD AND BAD OUTPUT: useful light and harmful smoke share one verb.
branches.cn: 好输出与坏输出：有用的光与有害的烟共用一个动词。

branches.en: PHYSICAL AND HUMAN: a lamp and a speaker both emit.
branches.cn: 物与人：灯和说话者都在 emit。

intro.en: Emit is e-, out, plus the Latin root mit, send, with the English verb ending -t.
intro.cn: emit 是 e-（向外）加拉丁词根 mit（发送），再接英语动词词尾 -t。

latinIntro.en: Mittere and emittere are recorded Latin verbs; emission came through French.
latinIntro.cn: mittere 与 emittere 是有记录的拉丁语动词；emission 则经法语传入。

definition_zh: 举起；起伏；抛出
definition_en: to lift or pull something heavy with effort, to rise and fall, or to throw something
core_image: 一个人弯腰抱住重箱，憋气把它抬离地面
scene: 他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。 They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
sceneCN: 这里 heave 是「举起」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。

senses.title: Lift with effort
senses.definition: to lift or pull something heavy with great effort
senses.definitionCN: 费力地抬起或拉动重物
senses.example: They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。
senses.why: This is effort applied to weight.
senses.whyCN: 这是把力气用在重量上。

senses.title: Rise and fall
senses.definition: to move up and down in a heavy way
senses.definitionCN: 沉重地上下起伏
senses.example: His chest heaved as he ran.
senses.exampleCN: 他跑步时胸口剧烈起伏。
senses.why: Breath and waves rise and fall.
senses.whyCN: 呼吸与波浪都一起一伏。

senses.title: Throw something
senses.definition: to throw something heavy
senses.definitionCN: 用力扔出沉重的东西
senses.example: They heaved the rope over the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把绳子抛过墙头。
senses.why: Throwing is lifting and letting go.
senses.whyCN: 抛出，就是抬起再放手。

intro.en: Heave comes from Old English hebban, to lift.
intro.cn: heave 来自古英语 hebban，意为举起。

items.en: Hebban meant to lift or raise.
items.cn: hebban 意为举起、抬起。

items.en: The root also named the sky, the lifted roof.
items.cn: 这个词根也构成「天空」，即抬起的天顶。

items.en: Heven kept the sense of lifting heavily.
items.cn: 中古英语 heven 仍指费力抬起。

items.en: Heave described the rise and fall of waves.
items.cn: heave 用来描写波浪起伏。

items.en: A sigh is something the chest heaves out.
items.cn: 叹气，是胸腔把气抬出去。

note.en: Heave is compared with look-alike words and with words for lifting.
note.cn: 把 heave 与形近词以及表示举起的词作比较。

entries.definition: the home of God
weighing a lot
to go away from
to move something upward
to pull something heavy
to move upward

normalIntro.en: Heave is effort made visible in a lifted weight.
normalIntro.cn: heave 是力气在重量上显出的形状。

normal.en: They heaved the log onto the fire.
normal.cn: 他们把木头抬到火上。

normal.en: He heaved a deep sigh.
normal.cn: 他深深叹了口气。

normal.en: The sea heaved in the storm.
normal.cn: 暴风雨里大海起伏翻涌。

normal.en: She heaved the bag onto her shoulder.
normal.cn: 她把包甩上肩膀。

normal.en: The ship heaved into view.
normal.cn: 那艘船出现在视野里。

abstract.en: To heave is to argue with gravity.
abstract.cn: 用力举起，就是和重力讲道理。

abstract.en: A sigh is the chest letting go.
abstract.cn: 一声叹息，是胸腔在放手。

abstract.en: Waves heave because the sea is breathing.
abstract.cn: 波浪起伏，因为海在呼吸。

examples.en: They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
examples.cn: 他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。

examples.en: His chest heaved as he ran.
examples.cn: 他跑步时胸口剧烈起伏。

examples.en: They heaved the rope over the wall.
examples.cn: 他们把绳子抛过墙头。

dict_mnemonic.text: heave 的核心是「用力抬」；抬重物是举起，胸口一起一伏是起伏，把绳子甩过墙是抛出，heave a sigh 则是把一口气抬出来，也就是叹气。

root: 来自古英语 hebban（举起），属日耳曼语词，与「天空」一词同源；由举起的动作，引申为上下起伏，再引申为用力抛出。

sensesIntro.en: Heave is a heavy lift, a rising and falling motion, or a hard throw.
sensesIntro.cn: heave 是费力的一举、一起一伏的动作，或用力的一抛。

core.en: A back bent under a heavy crate.
core.cn: 一个在重箱下弯下去的背。

branches.en: Two men raise a crate together.
branches.cn: 两个人一起抬起木箱。

branches.en: A runner's chest rises and falls.
branches.cn: 跑者的胸口一起一伏。

branches.en: A rope flies over the wall.
branches.cn: 一根绳子飞过墙头。

branches.en: Lifting makes the breath come harder.
branches.cn: 用力抬起，让呼吸更粗重。

branches.en: The sea lifts a boat, then drops it.
branches.cn: 海把船托起，又把它放下。

intro.en: Heave takes verb endings and builds descriptive and noun forms.
intro.cn: heave 加动词词尾，并构成描写性形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

definition_zh: 流血；渗漏；榨取
definition_en: to lose blood from the body
core_image: 手指被纸划破后渗出的血珠
scene: 纸边划破了她的手指，血珠慢慢鼓起来。 His hand bled for a minute or two.
sceneCN: 这里 bleed 是「流血」（第 1 个义项：血液从身体流出）；句意是他的手流了一两分钟的血。

pos.zh: 动词：榨取钱财，使人耗尽资源

derivatives.zh: 易出血的人，口语中也指血友病患者

senses.title: To lose blood
senses.definition: to lose blood from a wound or the body
senses.definitionCN: 因伤口或身体原因失去血液
senses.example: His hand bled for a minute or two.
senses.exampleCN: 他的手流了一两分钟的血。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, tied directly to blood.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，与 blood 直接相连。

senses.title: To let liquid escape
senses.definition: to let a liquid flow out slowly
senses.definitionCN: 让液体慢慢流出
senses.example: The old pipe was bleeding water onto the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 旧管子把水漏到了地板上。
senses.why: A leaking pipe looked like a wound that would not close.
senses.whyCN: 漏水的管子像一道合不上的伤口。

senses.title: To drain someone of money
senses.definition: to take too much money or strength from someone
senses.definitionCN: 从某人身上拿走过多钱财或精力
senses.example: The scheme bled the company dry.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划把公司的钱榨干了。
senses.why: Losing money was pictured as losing blood.
senses.whyCN: 失去钱财被比作失血。

intro.en: Bleed is the verb built on blood in Old English.
intro.cn: bleed 是古英语里由 blood 派生出的动词。

items.en: bledan came from blod, the word for blood.
items.cn: bledan 由表示血的 blod 派生而来。

items.en: bleed kept the bodily sense.
items.cn: bleed 保留了身体流血的意思。

items.en: bleed described a wound that would not stop.
items.cn: bleed 形容止不住的伤口。

items.en: bleed extended to pipes and leaks.
items.cn: bleed 扩展到管道与渗漏。

items.en: bleed also means to drain money.
items.cn: 如今 bleed 也指榨干钱财。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one sound; the near-meaning group names leaking and draining.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个音；近义组是渗漏与排干的词。

entries.definition: to keep animals for young
to mix things together
cold and without hope
to flow out slowly
to let liquid escape by accident
to draw liquid or money away

normalIntro.en: Bleed is blood in action, and anything that leaks can bleed.
normalIntro.cn: bleed 是血的动词形态，任何会漏的东西都可以 bleed。

normal.en: The past tense is bled, not bleeded.
normal.cn: 过去式是 bled，不是 bleeded。

normal.en: Bleed and blood share the bl- and the long vowel.
normal.cn: bleed 与 blood 共用开头并同属一个词族。

normal.en: A bleeding wound needs pressure.
normal.cn: 流血的伤口需要按压。

normal.en: Bleed dry means take every last penny.
normal.cn: bleed dry 指把最后一分钱都榨走。

normal.en: Pipes bleed water when they leak.
normal.cn: 管子漏水时就像在流血。

abstract.en: See a red drop swell on a fingertip.
abstract.cn: 想象指尖鼓起一颗血珠。

abstract.en: See water spreading under a sink.
abstract.cn: 想象水在水槽下漫开。

abstract.en: See an empty wallet after a bad deal.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔亏本买卖后空空的钱包。

examples.en: His hand bled for a minute or two.
examples.cn: 他的手流了一两分钟的血。

examples.en: The old pipe was bleeding water onto the floor.
examples.cn: 旧管子把水漏到了地板上。

examples.en: The scheme bled the company dry.
examples.cn: 这个计划把公司的钱榨干了。

dict_mnemonic.text: blood 是血，bleed 是流血，两个词开头相同，把名词和动词一起记。

root: bleed 源自古英语 bledan，由 blod（血）派生，过去式 bled 沿用至今；由身体流血引申为液体渗漏，再引申为榨干钱财。

sensesIntro.en: Blood leaving a body, water leaving a pipe, money leaving a company.
sensesIntro.cn: 血离开身体、水离开管道、钱离开公司。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bead of blood rising from a paper cut.
core.cn: 核心意象：纸割伤后渗出的血珠。

branches.en: bleed from a cut
branches.cn: 从伤口流血

branches.en: bleed to death
branches.cn: 失血而死

branches.en: a bleeding pipe
branches.cn: 漏水的管子

branches.en: bleed someone dry
branches.cn: 把某人榨干

branches.en: a scheme that bleeds money
branches.cn: 不断吸钱的计划

intro.en: Bleed has an irregular past and a small noun family.
intro.cn: bleed 的过去式不规则，并有一小族名词形式。

latinIntro.en: The base is Old English; Latin items below are related in meaning.

an injury that cuts the skin

definition_zh: 半导体；半导体材料；半导体器件
definition_en: a material that conducts electricity only under certain conditions, or a device made from such a material
core_image: 一块灰亮的硅片，一半在光下反光，一半沉在阴影里
scene: 手机里的芯片由半导体材料制成。 The chip in the phone is made of semiconductor material.
sceneCN: 这里 semiconductor 是「半导体」（第 1 个义项）；句意：手机里的芯片由半导体材料制成。

senses.title: The material
senses.definition: a solid whose ability to carry electricity lies between a conductor and an insulator
senses.definitionCN: 导电能力介于导体与绝缘体之间的固体材料
senses.example: The chip in the phone is made of semiconductor material.
senses.exampleCN: 手机里的芯片由半导体材料制成。
senses.why: This is the basic material sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的材料义。

senses.title: The device
senses.definition: an electronic component built from such a material
senses.definitionCN: 用这种材料制成的电子元件
senses.example: The factory makes semiconductors for computers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂为电脑生产半导体器件。
senses.why: The material name transfers to the parts made from it.
senses.whyCN: 材料名转指用它制成的零件。

intro.en: Semiconductor joins Latin semi, half, with conductor, from Latin conducere, to lead together.
intro.cn: semiconductor 由拉丁语 semi（一半）与 conductor 组合，后者出自拉丁语 conducere（引导到一起）。

items.en: Semi meant half.
items.cn: semi 意为一半。

items.en: Conducere meant to lead together.
items.cn: conducere 意为引导到一起。

items.en: Conductor named something that carries heat or electricity.
items.cn: conductor 指传导热或电的物体。

items.en: The term semiconductor appeared in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: semiconductor 一词出现在十九世纪。

items.en: It became central to modern electronics.
items.cn: 它后来成为现代电子技术的核心。

note.en: Semiconductor is compared with similar-looking electrical words and with related device words.
note.cn: 把 semiconductor 与形近的电学词以及相关器件词作比较。

entries.definition: a material that carries electricity or heat
a material that blocks electricity or heat

normalIntro.en: Semiconductor means half-conductor: it carries current only when conditions allow.
normalIntro.cn: semiconductor 意为半导，只在条件合适时导电。

normal.en: Semi means half, as in semicircle.
normal.cn: semi 意为一半，如 semicircle 所示。

normal.en: A conductor leads power; a semiconductor leads it partly.
normal.cn: 导体引导电流，半导体只部分引导。

normal.en: Silicon is the best-known semiconductor.
normal.cn: 硅是最著名的半导体。

normal.en: Chips are built from semiconductor layers.
normal.cn: 芯片由半导体层构成。

normal.en: Heat and light can change how a semiconductor behaves.
normal.cn: 热与光能改变半导体的表现。

abstract.en: A thing between two extremes can be more useful than either.
abstract.cn: 位于两个极端之间的东西，可能比两端更有用。

abstract.en: Control over when current flows is the heart of computing.
abstract.cn: 对电流何时流动的控制，是计算的核心。

abstract.en: Small switches, repeated by millions, change the world.
abstract.cn: 微小的开关重复百万次，改变了世界。

examples.en: The chip in the phone is made of semiconductor material.
examples.cn: 手机里的芯片由半导体材料制成。

examples.en: The factory makes semiconductors for computers.
examples.cn: 这家工厂为电脑生产半导体器件。

examples.en: Researchers are testing a new semiconductor.
examples.cn: 研究人员正在测试一种新的半导体。

dict_mnemonic.text: semiconductor 由 semi（一半）加 conductor（导体）构成，字面即「一半导体」，指导电能力介于导体与绝缘体之间的材料。

root: 由拉丁语 semi（一半）加 conductor（导体）构成，核心义「半导电的材料」。

sensesIntro.en: Semiconductor means a material that conducts only partly, or a device made from it.
sensesIntro.cn: semiconductor 意为部分导电的材料，或用它制成的器件。

core.en: A material that sits between conductor and insulator.
core.cn: 介于导体与绝缘体之间的材料。

branches.en: Silicon and similar solids.
branches.cn: 硅及类似的固体。

branches.en: Chips and transistors built from the material.
branches.cn: 由这种材料制成的芯片与晶体管。

branches.en: The material and the part share one name.
branches.cn: 材料与零件共用一个名称。

branches.en: Its behavior changes with heat and light.
branches.cn: 它的行为随热与光而变化。

branches.en: It made modern computers possible.
branches.cn: 它使现代计算机成为可能。

intro.en: Semiconductor belongs to the Latin semi family and the conductor family.
intro.cn: semiconductor 同时属于拉丁语 semi（半）词族与 conductor（导体）词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin semi is the historical prefix; conducere is the base of conductor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 semi 是历史前缀；conducere 是 conductor 的词根。

items.example: The note rises by a semitone.

definition_zh: 智慧；明智；学问；（前人的）经验之谈
definition_en: the ability to judge well and act sensibly, gained through knowledge and long experience
core_image: 老人坐在院里的树下，听完年轻人的问题，沉默了一会儿才慢慢开口
scene: 老人听完那个难题，先笑了，又沉默了一会儿才慢慢开口，一句话把纷乱理清。 She had the wisdom to say nothing until everyone had spoken.
sceneCN: 这里 wisdom 是「智慧」（第 1 个义项：判断得当、行事合理的能力）；句意为她很有智慧，等所有人都说完才开口。老人在树下先沉默再开口的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 智慧；明智；学问；经验之谈

senses.title: Good judgement from experience
senses.definition: the ability to make sound judgements, built from knowledge and years of experience
senses.definitionCN: 做出稳妥判断的能力，由知识与多年经验积累而成
senses.example: She had the wisdom to say nothing until everyone had spoken.
senses.exampleCN: 她很有智慧，等所有人都说完才开口。
senses.why: The ending -dom names a state, as in freedom and kingdom, so wisdom is the state of being wise.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -dom 命名一种状态，如 freedom、kingdom，所以 wisdom 就是处于明智的状态。

senses.title: Knowledge stored in books
senses.definition: the collected learning of a civilisation, often the sayings and books of the past
senses.definitionCN: 一个文明积存的学识，常指往昔的格言与典籍
senses.example: The library keeps the wisdom of three thousand years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座图书馆收藏着三千年的学问。
senses.why: When judgement is written down, it becomes a body of knowledge that later readers can inherit.
senses.whyCN: 当判断被写下来，它就成了一部可供后来者承继的知识。

senses.title: What most people believe
senses.definition: in phrases such as conventional wisdom, the opinion that is widely accepted, whether right or wrong
senses.definitionCN: 在 conventional wisdom 等说法中，指被广泛接受的看法，对错不论
senses.example: Conventional wisdom said the shop could never survive in a village.
senses.exampleCN: 通行看法认为这家店在村里绝无生路。
senses.why: The word keeps a slight irony here: the wisdom of the many is only a belief they share.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词带一点反讽：众人的智慧，只是众人共有的相信。

intro.en: Wisdom joins the adjective wise to the old suffix -dom, a Germanic ending that turns a quality into a state, as in kingdom.
intro.cn: wisdom 把形容词 wise 与古词尾 -dom 相连，这个日耳曼语词尾把品质变成状态，如 kingdom。

items.en: wīsdōm was a compound of wīs, wise, and dōm, judgement or decree.
items.cn: wīsdōm 是 wīs（明智的）与 dōm（判断、裁定）的复合词。

items.en: Because dōm meant judgement rather than a mere state, the word first stressed the act of deciding well.
items.cn: 由于 dōm 意为判断而非单纯状态，这个词起初强调的是判断得宜这一行为。

items.en: The compound settled as wisdom, and came to mean the learning of the old and the sages.
items.cn: 复合词固定为 wisdom，进而指老人与贤者的学识。

items.en: Books of wisdom, especially in the Bible, gave the word a lasting link with written teaching.
items.cn: 智慧书，尤其圣经中的智慧书，让这个词与书面教诲结下长久联系。

items.en: Conventional wisdom and wisdom tooth show the word widening to shared opinion and to the late tooth.
items.cn: conventional wisdom 与 wisdom tooth 显示这个词扩展到共同看法与那颗迟来的牙。

note.en: The first group collects words built with -dom or the same stem, the second covers other names for good judgement.
note.cn: 第一组收以 -dom 或以同一词干构成的词，第二组收其他表示良好判断的称呼。

entries.definition: The adjective that stands behind it.
In a sensible, careful way.
The state of being free.
A country ruled by a king or queen.
Facts and understanding gathered over time.
A deep and clear understanding of a problem.
Foolish behaviour that shows no judgement.

normalIntro.en: Wisdom is wise plus -dom, so it names the state of being wise, not a person who is wise.
normalIntro.cn: wisdom 是 wise 加 -dom，命名的是明智的状态，而不是某个明智的人。

normal.en: The ending -dom also builds kingdom and freedom: states of being.
normal.cn: 词尾 -dom 也构成 kingdom、freedom：都是某种状态。

normal.en: The i in wise shortens in wisdom: wide becomes width the same way.
normal.cn: wise 的 i 在 wisdom 里变短，wide 变 width 也是同理。

normal.en: Wisdom is knowledge plus time, so picture grey hair rather than a book.
normal.cn: 智慧是知识加上时间，所以要想灰白的头发，而不是一本书。

normal.en: A wisdom tooth arrives late, just as judgement arrives later than teeth.
normal.cn: 智齿来得晚，正如判断比牙齿来得更晚。

normal.en: Conventional wisdom is the wisdom of the crowd, often right and sometimes wrong.
normal.cn: conventional wisdom 是众人的智慧，常常对，有时也错。

abstract.en: A long pause before a short answer.
abstract.cn: 一个长停顿之后的那句短话。

abstract.en: A hand held up to stop a young man from rushing.
abstract.cn: 一只举起的手，拦住要冲出去的年轻人。

abstract.en: Quiet in a room where everyone else is certain.
abstract.cn: 满屋人都很确定时，那份安静。

examples.en: Age had given him patience rather than wisdom.
examples.cn: 年岁给他的更多是耐心而不是智慧。

examples.en: It is not wisdom to borrow money for a holiday.
examples.cn: 为了度假借钱，不算明智。

examples.en: The book gathers the wisdom of farmers across four generations.
examples.cn: 这本书汇集了四代农人的经验之谈。

dict_mnemonic.text: wise（明智的）+ dom（状态）—— 明智的状态，就是「智慧」。

root: 古英语 wīs（明智的）+ dōm（判断、裁定）→ wīsdōm → wisdom；同族有 wise、wisely、unwise。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins as good judgement, then becomes the accumulated learning of the past, and finally the everyday beliefs people share.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从良好的判断开始，成为往昔积累的学识，最后成了人们共有的日常看法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old man silent under a tree before he speaks.
core.cn: 核心意象：树下沉默良久才开口的老人。

branches.en: The judgement branch: saying nothing until all have spoken.
branches.cn: 判断分支：等所有人说完才开口。

branches.en: The learning branch: three thousand years on the shelves.
branches.cn: 学识分支：书架上三千年的积累。

branches.en: The belief branch: the crowd's opinion about the shop.
branches.cn: 看法分支：众人对那家店的判断。

branches.en: The irony branch: shared belief is not always wise.
branches.cn: 反讽分支：共有的看法并不总是明智。

branches.en: The inheritance branch: what one age hands to the next.
branches.cn: 传承分支：一个时代交给下一个时代的东西。

intro.en: Wisdom is a Germanic compound of wise and the state suffix -dom; the same suffix appears in freedom and kingdom.
intro.cn: wisdom 是 wise 与状态词尾 -dom 组成的日耳曼语复合词；同样的词尾出现在 freedom、kingdom 里。

latinIntro.en: The word is native, with no Latin ancestor; the Latin entries below are borrowed cousins for the same idea.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是本土词，没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁条目只是表达同一观念的借入表亲。

items.exampleCN: 迟来之物借用同一观念命名。
